youtube.title: ₹500 SIP: Can It Make You a Crorepati? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Can a ₹500 SIP make you a crorepati? Yes, but slowly. At an assumed 12% a year, ₹500 a month grows to about ₹1.16 lakh in 10 years, about ₹17.6 lakh in 30 years, and crosses ₹1 crore in about 44 years. Add a 10% step-up every year and you get there about 8 years sooner (around 36 years).

Numbers in this video:
• Standard SIP future-value maths, monthly investing, 1% a month (12% a year) assumed for illustration
• ₹500 a month: ₹60,000 invested over 10 years ≈ ₹1.16 lakh; ₹1.8 lakh over 30 years ≈ ₹17.6 lakh
• About 70% of the final ₹1 crore arrives in the last 10 years
Real returns go up and down, and nothing is guaranteed.

What's your SIP amount, and when do you plan to step it up? Comment below.
